achievements.name: First Tracks
achievements.description: Complete your first hunt in the night wilds.

achievements.name: First Handshake
achievements.description: Complete your first trade with another hunter.

achievements.name: First Forging
achievements.description: Upgrade an item for the first time.

achievements.name: First Legendary Loot
achievements.description: Loot your first Legendary (or better) item.

achievements.name: Sharpened
achievements.description: Upgrade any weapon to its maximum level.

events.description: Once a year the night sea rises glowing, and the shore fills with sprites drawn to the light. Hunters who brave the shining water during the Lumen Tide may earn treasures that surface only when the tide is bright.
events.title: The Lumen Tide

items.description: A wandering spark of green-gold light that nests in damp hollows and rotten logs. It feeds on moonbeams and drifting spores, and hunters say a moss-wisp will bob beside you on a dark trail, quietly guiding your steps home.
items.name: Moss Wisp

items.description: Its wings are tattered veils of dusk-grey that drink the last of the daylight. The gloom-moth gathers where shadows pool deepest, and when it settles on a hunter's shoulder it means the night has noticed you — and found you worthy.
items.name: Gloom Moth

items.description: A fox wreathed in harmless cinders, its tail a slow-burning banner that never consumes itself. It dens near old campfires and ash pits, stealing embers to feed its glow, and legends claim it can find any path it has walked before, even in total darkness.
items.name: Ember Fox

items.description: A small drake of salt and spray that rides the night tide like a current of living water. It sleeps curled in tidepools and wakes only when the sea is brightest, trading one of its shed scales for a secret whispered into the foam.
items.name: Tide Drake

items.description: A stag whose antlers are living crystal, humming faintly whenever starlight strikes them. It appears only where the forest floor holds old quartz seams, and hunters who meet its gaze speak of suddenly remembering every path they ever lost.
items.name: Quartz Stag

items.description: A serpent woven from the shadow cast by the world itself, moving through darkness the way other snakes move through grass. It sheds its darkness once a century, and those who witness the shedding say the shed skin holds every nightmare the serpent ever swallowed.
items.name: Umbral Serpent

items.description: The last ember of a universe that burned out before this one was kindled. It does not fly so much as fall upward through the dark between stars, and to hold its gaze is to remember that endings are only doors with the lights turned off. It can never be sold or traded — it belongs to whoever earned it.
items.name: Void Phoenix

items.description: A slim blade forged from a bell that never rang, so it cuts without sound. Scouts carry it through thicket and ruin alike, for it parts bramble and rope as easily as it parts silence.
items.name: Whisper Dagger

items.description: A blade wrapped in living thorns that drink from the wielder's courage and grow sharper for it. Cuttings taken from its edge, planted at a doorway, are said to keep honest homes safe through the longest nights.
items.name: Thornblade

items.description: Carved from the heartwood of a tree that blooms only under moonlight, its limbs strung with silvered vine. Arrows loosed from it fly silent and true, leaving a trail of pale petals that fade before they touch the ground.
items.name: Moonpetal Bow

items.description: A longsword quenched in dragon-ash, its fuller holding a line of fire that never dies. It warms the hand that deserves it and burns the hand that does not, and old soldiers swear it hums low when battle is near.
items.name: Emberbrand

items.description: Raised from a drowned temple by the Lumen Tide itself, its three tines still weep seawater. When it strikes, the sound of distant surf follows, and those who master it can feel the pull of every tide within a hundred leagues.
items.name: Tidecaller Trident

items.description: Forged from a single fallen star, cooled in the light of its own descent. It fell once and will never fall again; no smith living can reforge it, so its power is fixed and absolute. When it strikes stone, the stone remembers being sky.
items.name: Starfall Hammer
Dew Darter
items.description: A needle of living quicksilver that skims pond-skins at first light, drinking the dew before the sun can claim it. Hunters follow its glittering trail to find clean water, for a dew-darter never nests near anything poisoned.

items.name: Bark Beetle
items.description: Its shell is a perfect knot of oak-bark, invisible until it moves. It spends its nights polishing fallen acorns with its mandibles, and foresters say a tree watched over by bark-beetles never rots from within.

items.name: Lantern Mite
items.description: A mite no bigger than a thumbnail, carrying a green lantern-glow in its abdomen. They gather in hollow reeds after rain, and travelers use their clusters as living candles that never burn out.

items.name: Soot Sparrow
items.description: A sparrow blackened by campfire smoke, with eyes like banked coals. It nests in cold chimneys through summer and migrates toward every autumn bonfire, singing in a voice like crackling logs.

items.name: Puddle Skink
items.description: A skink the color of rain on stone, quick as a blink between puddles. It remembers every pool it has ever swum in, and during droughts it leads other thirsty creatures to the hidden ones.

items.name: Bramble Hare
items.description: A hare whose fur has tangled itself into a living briar, thorns and all. Foxes learn young not to bite it, and its burrows are ringed with blackberry canes no predator will push through.

items.name: Mist Cub
items.description: A bear cub woven from morning fog, solid only when you try to touch it. It pads behind hunters on white mornings and dissolves by noon, leaving pawprints full of cold water.

items.name: Cinder Cricket
items.description: A cricket that chirps in sparks, each note a tiny ember flickering from its wings. On still nights whole fields of them pulse in rhythm, and shepherds read the weather in their tempo.

items.name: Thorn Mouse
items.description: A mouse armored in rose-thorns, soft-bellied and sharp-backed. It sleeps curled inside hollow thistles and is said to dream the dreams of the garden it guards.

items.name: Glowcap Frog
items.description: A frog with a mushroom cap glowing soft blue atop its head, lighting its own lily pad. It croaks in perfect pitch with its neighbors, and whole ponds of them sing in slow round harmonies.

items.name: Dusk Firefly
items.description: Larger than its daylight cousins, it kindles its lamp only at true dusk and flies in slow spirals. Poets claim each spiral spells a word, and that fireflies are the night's way of writing letters.

items.name: Pebble Turtle
items.description: A turtle whose shell is a single smooth river-stone, grown around it grain by grain. It can sleep for a season buried in streambeds, waking when the water warms with a century of patience in its eyes.

items.name: Root Sprite
items.description: A knotted little spirit of root-tips and dark soil, with fingers like radish sprouts. It loosens the earth around young trees and sulks when hunters step carelessly on its tender shoots.

items.name: Fern Wren
items.description: A wren the green of new ferns, nesting in the curled heart of fiddleheads. Its song sounds like rain arriving, and gardeners plant ferns hoping to borrow its luck.

items.name: Hollow Owl
items.description: An owl that nests only in hollow trees struck by lightning, its feathers smelling faintly of ozone. It sees the heat of living things, and hunters follow its gaze to find game on moonless nights.

items.name: Silt Eel
items.description: A blind eel of river silt, navigating by the taste of currents. It braids itself into the mud during floods and emerges afterward, fat and unbothered, as if the river had merely blinked.

items.name: Acorn Imp
items.description: A capering imp wearing an acorn cup as a helm, forever stealing shiny things and hiding them in tree hollows. It returns every theft at midwinter, leaving its hoard in a neat pile as apology.

items.name: Nightdew Slug
items.description: A slug that drinks only the dew that falls after midnight, trailing silver. Its slime sweetens the soil it crosses, and night-gardeners prize the pale flowers that follow in its wake.

items.name: Ember Moth
items.description: A moth drawn to every flame yet never burned, its wings dusted with ash that never falls. It sleeps in cold hearths by day and dances in chimney smoke by night, spelling nothing, meaning everything.

items.name: Frost Mite
items.description: A mite of living hoarfrost that grazes on windowpanes in deep winter. Where a colony settles, the ice blooms into ferns and feathers no artist could copy.

items.name: Whisper Bat
items.description: A bat whose wings make no sound at all, only a pressure like a held breath. It hunts moths by listening to their wingbeats and is the only creature the moths never hear coming.

items.name: Clover Faun
items.description: A faun no taller than a boot, crowned with four-leaf clover. It blesses the fields it dances through, and farmers leave out thimbles of milk to keep it near their crops.

items.name: Bog Lantern
items.description: A floating wisp that haunts marshes, neither kind nor cruel, simply curious. It lights the safe paths through the mire for those who ask politely, and leads the rude in circles until dawn.

items.name: Twig Snake
items.description: A snake indistinguishable from a fallen twig until it blinks. It hunts by absolute stillness, sometimes waiting a whole season for one perfect strike, and never hurries for anything.

items.name: Moon Mole
items.description: A mole with fur like crushed velvet that surfaces only under a full moon. It digs its tunnels by starlight and lines them with white pebbles, building pale underground maps of the sky.

items.name: Ash Rabbit
items.description: A rabbit grey as hearth-ash, born in the warm cinders of forest fires. It outruns everything but curiosity, and always doubles back to see what chased it.

items.name: Creek Minnow
items.description: A minnow bright as a slipped coin, quick as gossip. Schools of them turn in the current like a single thinking thing, and anglers say they can read tomorrow's weather in the pattern.

items.name: Dusk Mantis
items.description: A mantis the color of the last light, praying to a sun already gone. It strikes faster than the eye can follow and then resumes its devotions as if nothing had happened.

items.name: Silverfox Kit
items.description: A fox kit with fur like brushed moonlight, still clumsy with its own magic. It practices turning invisible on its own tail and is always surprised when it works.

items.name: Storm Petrel
items.description: A seabird that nests in the heart of thunderstorms, riding lightning updrafts like stairs. Sailors count it a blessing to see one, for where the petrel flies, the storm is already passing.

items.name: Moonlit Fawn
items.description: A fawn dappled with actual moonlight that never fades, even at noon. It drinks from silver pools and leaves hoofprints that glow faintly until the next rain.

items.name: Ember Salamander
items.description: A salamander that basks in open flame as others bask in sun, its skin cool to the touch despite the fire. Alchemists prize its shed skin, which holds warmth for a hundred years.

items.name: Frost Fox
items.description: A fox whose breath falls as snow, no matter the season. It hunts across frozen lakes of its own making, and its den is always winter, even in high summer.

items.name: Shadow Crow
items.description: A crow that is only ever seen from the corner of the eye, its caw arriving a moment before it does. It collects lost buttons and broken promises, caching them in hollow trees.

items.name: Tide Heron
items.description: A heron that fishes the tide line with legs like stilts of driftwood. It stands motionless for hours, and when it strikes, the water itself seems to flinch.

items.name: Crystal Lizard
items.description: A lizard with scales of flawed quartz that catch light in rainbow fractures. It suns itself on geode outcrops and can go months without eating, living on light alone.

items.name: Dream Eel
items.description: An eel that swims through sleeping minds as easily as rivers. It feeds on bad dreams, leaving sleepers with only the pleasant ones, and is welcomed wherever nightmares gather.

items.name: Thornwolf Pup
items.description: A wolf pup with briars growing through its pelt, already practicing its fearsome howl. The pack's thorns grow sharper with every hunt, and the pup's are still soft as grass.

items.name: Gale Kite
items.description: A kite that hunts on the wind's edge, never flapping, only tilting. It can hang motionless in a gale for hours, watching the ground with eyes like polished slate.

items.name: Lantern Jelly
items.description: A jellyfish that pulses with warm lantern-light, drifting the night currents like a lost festival. Small fish follow it for safety, and it does not mind the company.

items.name: Copper Serpent
items.description: A serpent with scales of green-patina copper, warm as a held coin. It coils around old machinery and purrs — a low metallic hum — when the gears are well-oiled.

items.name: Veil Deer
items.description: A deer perpetually half-hidden by a veil of its own mist, antlers dripping fog. Hunters who glimpse it speak of it for years, though none can say exactly what they saw.

items.name: Cinder Imp
items.description: An imp of half-smothered coals, sneezing sparks when excited. It tends dying campfires back to life unasked, then demands payment in stories.

items.name: Dusk Nightjar
items.description: A nightjar whose churring call slows time for those who listen closely. It nests on bare ground, invisible as a stone, and sings the sun down every evening without fail.

items.name: Opal Frog
items.description: A frog with opal skin that shifts color with its mood — blue when calm, fire-orange when startled. Its tadpoles are born transparent and color in like developing photographs.

items.name: Aurora Fox
items.description: A fox whose nine tails trail ribbons of aurora light across the night sky. It appears only during the true northern lights, hunting starlight the way other foxes hunt mice.

items.name: Storm Drake
items.description: A drake no longer than a man's arm, curled around thunderheads like a cat around a cushion. When it sneezes, lightning strikes, and it sneezes often.

items.name: Moonwell Serpent
items.description: A serpent that lives in wells so deep they catch the moon even at noon. It drinks moonlight and sweats silver, and its shed skins are used as mirrors by the fey.

items.name: Ash Phoenix
items.description: A young phoenix still grey with its first ash, practicing its immolation on candle flames. Each small death teaches it a new color, and it will not attempt the true fire until it knows them all.

items.name: Tide Calf
items.description: The calf of some vast deep-sea mother, stranded in a tidepool by a storm. It sings to the sea in a voice too low to hear, and the sea always answers, eventually.

items.name: Crystal Wyvern
items.description: A wyvern of living amethyst, its wingbeats ringing like struck glass. It perches on cliff edges and refracts the sunset into colors that have no names.

items.name: Shadow Panther
items.description: A panther made of the dark between heartbeats, visible only when it chooses. It hunts nightmares that escape from sleepers and is the reason most of them never reach you.

items.name: Starfoal
items.description: A foal fallen from a constellation, still trailing stardust from its hooves. It is trying to find its way back to the sky, and follows anyone who walks at night in hopes they know the road.

items.name: Frost Wyrm
items.description: A wyrm of glacier ice and old winter, slow as continents and twice as patient. Its breath flash-freezes waterfalls mid-cascade, and it considers this decoration.

items.name: Dreamstag
items.description: A stag that exists only in shared dreams, antlers hung with sleeping birds. Hunters who meet it wake with real leaves in their hair and no memory of how they got there.

items.name: Void Moth
items.description: A moth with wings like holes cut in the night, showing the nothing underneath. It is drawn to dying stars and carries their last light away in its antennae, to plant elsewhere.

items.name: Eclipse Dragon
items.description: A dragon that eats sunlight and exhales eclipse-shadow, coiled around the dark side of the moon. It wakes once a century to stretch, and every total eclipse is its yawn.

items.name: Worldroot Turtle
items.description: A turtle so old that a world-tree grows from its shell, roots and all. It has forgotten it is an animal at all and believes itself to be a small, slow country.

items.name: Storm Empress
items.description: A moth the size of a sail, crowned with lightning, ruling every storm on the western sea. Lesser storm-petrels attend her like courtiers, and she has never once been rained on.

items.name: Lunar Kirin
items.description: A kirin that walks only on moonbeams, hooves never touching ground. It appears to those who are lost in the truest sense, and sets them on a path they didn't know they needed.

items.name: Abyssal Leviathan
items.description: A leviathan of the lightless deep, older than the concept of fear. It dreams in pressures that would crush mountains, and its dreams sometimes surface as new islands.

items.name: Nightstar Dragon
items.description: A dragon born from the first star that ever died, its scales the color of the moment before dawn. It remembers the universe before there was anything to remember, and guards that memory jealously.

items.name: Dawnbringer
items.description: A phoenix of the first morning, carrying the original sunrise still burning in its chest. Every dawn since has been an echo of its wings, growing fainter with distance, never with love.

items.name: Rusted Shortsword
items.description: Pitted with rust and nicked along the edge, but honest. It has outlived three owners and expects to outlive a fourth, asking only to be wiped down after rain.

items.name: Oak Club
items.description: A length of oak root, heavy and unashamed of its simplicity. It has settled more arguments than any court, and never once been wrong about the outcome.

items.name: Flint Knife
items.description: Knapped from river flint in an afternoon, sharp as spite. It will not hold an edge for long, but while it holds, nothing argues with it.

items.name: Ash Spear
items.description: A spear of pale ash-wood, straight as a held breath. It was cut from a tree that survived lightning, and some of that stubbornness stayed in the grain.

items.name: Stone Sling
items.description: A shepherd's sling of braided wool, worn smooth by years of use. In practiced hands it can drop a rabbit at forty paces; in unpracticed hands it can drop the practitioner's dignity.

items.name: Bone Hatchet
items.description: Hafted with the leg-bone of something large and long dead. It carries a faint warmth, as if the original owner hasn't quite finished with it.

items.name: Thorn Whip
items.description: A whip braided from blackthorn, still green enough to bud in spring. It stings like an insult and leaves little leaf-shaped marks that itch for a week.

items.name: Copper Dagger
items.description: Soft as daggers go, and green at the edges, but it never rusts and never lies. Beggars' knives are copper, and beggars survive things kings don't.

items.name: Pine Bow
items.description: A simple bow of mountain pine, smelling of resin when drawn. It has no magic in it but the archer's, which is the only kind that ever mattered.

items.name: Iron Shiv
items.description: A prison-made shiv, ugly and effective. It has no honor and makes no promises, which is exactly why it always keeps them.

items.name: Driftwood Staff
items.description: A staff of sea-smoothed driftwood, light as a secret. It still remembers the ocean and hums faintly when the tide is turning, miles away.

items.name: Shard Axe
items.description: An axe headed with a single shard of quartz, sharp as broken promises. It chips a little more with every swing, and will one day be a dagger, then a knife, then a memory.

items.name: Hunter's Knife
items.description: A working knife, stained with a hundred small honest tasks. It has skinned rabbits, cut rope, and pried open exactly one cursed locket, which it refuses to discuss.

items.name: Root Maul
items.description: A maul carved from a single oak root-ball, dense as regret. It swings slow and lands like a verdict.

items.name: Glass Shard
items.description: A dagger of black volcanic glass, sharp enough to split a hair lengthwise. It is beautiful, treacherous, and exactly as fragile as it looks.

items.name: Driftwood Pike
items.description: A long pike of salt-cured driftwood, barnacled at the butt. It has tasted deep water and doesn't fear shallow trouble.

items.name: Ember Torch
items.description: A torch that never quite goes out, wrapped in oilcloth and stubbornness. As a weapon it is clumsy; as a companion on dark roads it is beyond price.

items.name: Fang Dagger
items.description: A dagger of wolf-fang, still sharp after a decade. The wolf it came from died of old age, and the dagger seems to know it, fighting almost gently.

items.name: Silvered Sabre
items.description: A cavalry sabre washed in silver, bright as a kept promise. It was made for fighting things that fear the moon, and it has never been disappointed.

items.name: Moonbow
items.description: A bow of pale yew that draws easier under moonlight, as if the night itself helps pull the string. Its arrows leave brief silver contrails, like tiny falling stars.

items.name: Runed Axe
items.description: An axe etched with runes no scholar can read, which glow faintly when orcs are near. The runes are probably just a warning; the axe itself is the argument.

items.name: Venom Dagger
items.description: A dagger with a hollow channel for venom, stoppered with wax. It has never been filled — its owner insists the threat alone is sharper than any poison.

items.name: Storm Javelin
items.description: A javelin balanced to fly true even in high wind, fletched with storm-petrel feathers. It hums in flight, a low note like distant thunder clearing its throat.

items.name: Ember Rapier
items.description: A duelist's rapier that warms in the hand when tempers rise. It has ended twelve duels and started three marriages, and considers both statistics respectable.

items.name: Frostbrand
items.description: A short sword that frosts over in summer heat, cold as a creditor's smile. It leaves white patterns on whatever it touches, like breath on a winter window.

items.name: Shadow Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow of blackened yew that makes no sound when loosed. The bolts are fletched with shadow-crow feathers and are notoriously difficult to dodge, mostly because they're difficult to see.

items.name: Coral Spear
items.description: A spear of living pink coral, still growing a fraction each year. It is as much a garden as a weapon, and small bright fish sometimes follow it, confused but hopeful.

items.name: Amber Maul
items.description: A maul with a head of solid amber, a bee visible inside, frozen mid-flight for a thousand years. It strikes with the weight of all that waiting.

items.name: Fangreaver
items.description: A brutal axe edged with wolf fangs, each one still sharp. It was made by someone with more enemies than friends, and it shows in the craftsmanship.

items.name: Dreamcatcher Staff
items.description: A staff crowned with a woven dreamcatcher of willow and sinew. It catches nightmares before they reach the sleeper, and the staff's owner sleeps like the dead.

items.name: Serpent Whip
items.description: A whip of cured serpent-hide that moves like it's still alive. It has never once struck its wielder, which its wielder attributes to mutual respect and everyone else to luck.

items.name: Featherblade
items.description: A blade light as its name, forged thin as a feather's vane. It cannot parry anything heavier than itself, so its wielder learned very quickly not to parry.

items.name: Twilight Glaive
items.description: A glaive whose blade is always the color of the sky at dusk, no matter the hour. It is most dangerous at twilight, when it becomes nearly invisible against the real thing.

items.name: Dragonscale Blade
items.description: A blade shingled with dragon scales, each one harder than steel and warm to the touch. The dragon donated them willingly, which is the most frightening part of the story.

items.name: Tidecaller Bow
items.description: A bow of drowned blackwood that draws with the resistance of deep water. Arrows fired from it fly with the sound of surf, and always find their mark on a rising tide.

items.name: Void Edge
items.description: A sword whose edge is a sliver of true nothing, cutting by removing. It makes no wound — the part it cuts simply stops having ever been there, which survivors describe as deeply unsettling.

items.name: Phoenix Talon
items.description: A dagger of phoenix talon, warm as fresh bread and sharp as heartbreak. If broken, it mends itself in flame, though it complains about the indignity the whole time.

items.name: Kraken Maw
items.description: An axe carved from a kraken's beak, black and hooked and faintly suction-cupped. It smells of the deep sea and grips like it remembers having tentacles.

items.name: Sunsteel Greatsword
items.description: A greatsword of sunsteel, bright as noon even in a lightless cave. It was quenched in the first light of midsummer's dawn and has carried that morning with it ever since.

items.name: Whisper Bow
items.description: A bow that makes no sound when drawn or loosed, strung with spider-silk. Its arrows arrive before their own noise, which archers describe as extremely rude, in the best way.

items.name: Nightfall Scythe
items.description: A scythe that reaps shadows instead of wheat, leaving the grain standing. It is favored by gardeners with philosophical leanings and assassins with practical ones.

items.name: Glacier Lance
items.description: A lance of never-melting glacier ice, cold enough to burn. It was cut from a berg that sank a ship, and it has never apologized.

items.name: Emberstorm Hammer
items.description: A hammer that strikes with the sound of a forest fire arriving. Each blow scatters sparks that spell nothing, but onlookers always try to read them.

items.name: Thorncrown Staff
items.description: A staff crowned with a circlet of living thorns that blooms once a year. The flowers are beautiful, poisonous, and extremely judgmental about who may hold the staff.

items.name: Starfall Blade
items.description: A blade forged from starfall iron, still faintly warm from its descent through the sky. It remembers being a star, and cuts with something like nostalgia for the light.

items.name: Worldtree Bow
items.description: A bow cut from a fallen branch of the world-tree, strung with a root that never snapped. Arrows loosed from it fly straighter than geometry allows, as if the world politely gets out of the way.

items.name: Chrono Dagger
items.description: A dagger that cuts a second before it moves, leaving wounds that happened slightly in the past. Its wielder is advised not to think about this too hard during a fight.

items.name: Abyssal Trident
items.description: A trident dredged from the lightless deep, crusted with things that have no names. It drips though it is dry, and the drips fall upward when no one is watching.

items.name: Solar Lance
items.description: A lance tipped with captured sunlight, bright enough to read by at midnight. It was charged at dawn and has been slowly spending that morning ever since.

items.name: Moonfall Scythe
items.description: A scythe forged from a fallen fragment of the moon, pale and impossibly light. It reaps moonlight from the air with every swing, leaving the night a little darker and the wielder a little brighter.

items.name: Kingsbane
items.description: The sword that ended a dynasty, plain and unadorned and terrible. It has tasted royal blood and found it no different from any other, which is exactly the lesson it was made to teach.

items.name: Worldsplitter
items.description: An axe that once split a mountain to settle a border dispute, and the border has been respected ever since. It leans toward violence the way rivers lean toward the sea.

items.name: Eternity Bow
items.description: A bow that has always existed and will always exist, merely borrowing its current archer. Every arrow it has ever loosed is still flying, somewhere, and will land exactly when needed.

items.name: Godslayer
items.description: The weapon that killed a god, though no two tellings agree on which one. It is heavier than it should be, as if carrying the weight of the thing it did, and it will never be drawn lightly again.

items.name: Rough Shard
items.description: An unworked shard of grey stone, sharp at one edge. Every great blade begins as something this humble, and the stone knows it.

items.name: Glow Mote
items.description: A mote of captured glow, warm between the fingers. It will light a forge or a hope with equal willingness.

items.name: Bark Strip
items.description: A strip of bark peeled from a lightning-struck oak. It still smells of the storm that marked the tree.

items.name: Dew Vial
items.description: A vial of dew gathered before sunrise, when it is purest. Smiths use it to quench small, precise things.

items.name: Ash Flake
items.description: A flake of ash from a dragon's hearth-fire, light as a secret. It burns cold and steady when coaxed.

items.name: Moss Knot
items.description: A knot of ancient moss, dense as felt. It binds wrappings and wounds with equal patience.

items.name: Pebble Charm
items.description: A smooth pebble worn in a pocket for luck, now smooth enough to set in a pommel. Luck, properly polished, is just preparation.

items.name: Twig Bundle
items.description: A bundle of straight young twigs, bound with twine. Good for hafts, handles, and starting over.

items.name: Firefly Ichor
items.description: The luminous ichor of a dozen fireflies, bottled at dusk. It lends its glow to whatever it tempers.

items.name: Moonpetal Dust
items.description: Dust ground from fallen moonpetals, silver and fragrant. It is used to silver edges that must never rust.

items.name: Iron Fleck
items.description: Flecks of raw iron panned from black sand. Unimpressive alone; indispensable in quantity.

items.name: Salt Crystal
items.description: A crystal of sea-salt, sharp as frost. It draws out impurities the way the sea draws out everything, eventually.

items.name: Ember Cinder
items.description: A cinder that never fully cooled, warm to the touch after years. Smiths keep one in every forge for luck and for lighting.

items.name: Frost Dew
items.description: Dew flash-frozen on the petal, preserved in a stoppered vial. It tempers steel with winter's patience.

items.name: Thorn Splinter
items.description: A splinter of blackthorn, hard as iron and twice as spiteful. It is driven into hilts to keep them honest.

items.name: Clay Effigy
items.description: A small clay figure of the weapon to be made, fired in a forge's breath. Smiths shape the effigy first, so the steel knows what is expected.

items.name: Bone Chip
items.description: A chip of old bone, yellowed and hard. It takes an edge well and holds a grudge longer.

items.name: Starling Feather
items.description: An iridescent starling feather, dark with hidden colors. It is bound into fletchings and into the occasional spell.

items.name: Silver Fleck
items.description: Flecks of true silver, bright as moonlight on water. Silver remembers the moon, and steel tempered with it remembers too.

items.name: Moonstone Chip
items.description: A chip of moonstone that glows from within, like a thought. It is set into blades meant to fight things of darkness.

items.name: Venom Sac
items.description: A sealed sac of serpent venom, handled with respect and long tongs. A single drop properly applied outlasts a dozen sharpenings.

items.name: Storm Feather
items.description: A feather shed by a storm-petrel mid-gale, still crackling faintly. It lends swiftness to whatever it fletches.

items.name: Ember Core
items.description: The still-burning heart of a banked forge-fire, contained in clay. It does not cool, does not dim, and does not forgive carelessness.

items.name: Frost Shard
items.description: A shard of never-melting ice, cold enough to numb the fingers through gloves. It gives blades a winter's patience and a winter's temper.

items.name: Shadow Wisp
items.description: A wisp of captured shadow, bottled in smoked glass. It is weightless, silent, and slightly resentful of the bottle.

items.name: Coral Fragment
items.description: A fragment of deep coral, pink as dawn through water. It is still faintly alive, and grows a little each year, even on a weapon.

items.name: Amber Drop
items.description: A drop of amber with something ancient inside — a bee, a leaf, a moment. Whatever it is, it has been waiting a long time to be useful.

items.name: Wolf Fang
items.description: A wolf's fang, clean and sharp and faintly mournful. The wolf is long gone; the sharpness remains, which is the point.

items.name: Serpent Scale
items.description: A single iridescent scale, shed willingly or taken unwillingly — the scale doesn't say. It is harder than it looks and prettier than it needs to be.

items.name: Dream Moth Wing
items.description: The wing of a moth that fed on dreams, dusted with sleep. Weapons edged with it are said to fight gently, putting foes to sleep instead of killing them.

items.name: Dragon Ash
items.description: Ash from a dragon's true-fire, grey-white and warm after a century. It remembers being flame the way old soldiers remember being young.

items.name: Tide Pearl
items.description: A pearl formed around a single grain of midnight sand, black and lustrous. It holds the sound of the deep sea; hold it to your ear and be humbled.

items.name: Void Mote
items.description: A mote of the void between stars, contained in leaded crystal. It is heavier than it should be and colder than it has any right to be.

items.name: Phoenix Down
items.description: A single down feather from a phoenix's rebirth, still warm. It smells of cinnamon and second chances.

items.name: Kraken Ink
items.description: Ink from the deep kraken, blacker than black and faintly luminous. It is used to etch runes that can only be read in darkness.

items.name: Sunsteel Fragment
items.description: A fragment of sunsteel that holds a permanent noon. Smiths work by its light and swear it makes them more honest.

items.name: Whisper Essence
items.description: Essence distilled from a thousand whispers, clear as water and twice as telling. Blades quenched in it learn to keep secrets.

items.name: Starfall Fragment
items.description: A fragment of a fallen star, still warm from its descent through the dark. It hums at a pitch only smiths can hear, and it is always humming about the sky.

items.name: Worldtree Sap
items.description: Sap from the world-tree itself, golden and slow as honey. A single drop can bind anything to anything, including, it is rumored, promises to people.

items.name: Chrono Sand
items.description: Sand from the shores of time's river, each grain a frozen moment. It pours upward when no one is watching, and smiths who use it age slightly less than they should.

items.name: Worn Blade
items.description: A trusty old blade given to every new hunter. It cannot be sold, but it can be upgraded and merged.
